os_version: Windows 11 Pro 26100, 1920x1080 @ 100% (96 DPI), French locale, live in-use machine
app: File Explorer (Win11, CabinetWClass shell window: Win32 list view + XAML islands toolbar/breadcrumb)

stack_detection.signature: CabinetWClass; UIA responds with a full 188-node tree on first query

channel_setup: UI Automation via Python `uiautomation`. Throwaway folder %TEMP%/pipeline-tap-explorer with 3 probe files; folder deleted after.

t1_read_text.detail: All shell text readable: file rows WITH their detail columns as values (Modifié le, Type, Taille), full breadcrumb path (Léandre>AppData>Local>Temp>...), status bar '3 élément(s)'.

t2_enumerate.detail: 3/3 files present as listitems with per-column edit values; toolbar (Nouveau/Couper/Copier/...), nav tree incl. the user's quick-access pins, tabs, search box — all with boxes matching the screenshot. HARNESS LESSON kept as data: the probe first scored 1/3 because it matched filesystem names ('alpha.txt') — Explorer hides known extensions, so the accessible names are 'alpha'/'gamma' exactly as PAINTED. The channel is faithful to the screen, not to the filesystem — which is precisely the property the thesis asks of it (the Type column 'Document texte'/'Fichier PNG' still discloses the kind).

t3_live_value.detail: Not run (typing in Explorer means rename/search — outside the throwaway perimeter for a shell showing the user's tree). Proven on Notepad/Calculator.

t4_living_screen.detail: Static folder; idle re-distill diff = 0 bytes. Living screen covered by windows-timedate-uia.

t5_blind_action.detail: Blind click at the center of 'listitem beta.md' from the published view line (guarded by ControlFromPoint top-level check); verified IN CHANNEL: [selected=False] flipped to [selected=True] on exactly that item, no other item selected. Screenshot confirms the blue highlight. Mirror of the macOS Finder AXSelected cell.

t6_pictorial.detail: Toolbar icons and file-type glyphs declared as [pixels] image 16x16 rects (explicit); no thumbnail content fabricated. In details view no pictorial region exists beyond icons.

measurements.notes: Cost inversion again, by density: 188 nodes -> 1470 tok vs 974 for the window screenshot (1139x641). The view carries MORE than the pixels though (full path, column values, pin list, selection states). Diff per interaction 877 B; idle 0. Capture 186-222 ms — the slowest UIA app so far (deep shell tree, XAML islands). Breadcrumb/address-bar elements appear twice (XAML dual-role duplicates), inflating cost ~10%; a smarter distiller could dedupe.

runtime_verification.method: screenshot after the blind click compared against the post-click channel state
runtime_verification.agreement: full agreement: names without extensions exactly as painted, beta.md highlighted+selected, status bar counts match
